Proves AR-6's `in` operator on a `decimal` field (AR-7), via the Set Filter wire shape (`{filterType:'set', values:[...]}`), each wire string coerced once into the field's declared type (SEM-5); SEM-2: `in` never matches null. The values are numeric strings (AR-7), so a host binds the set as `text[]`; per SQL-4 Postgres casts the array, `"unit_cost" = ANY($1::numeric[])`, because `numeric = text` does not exist (Bug #2304). Members compare as numbers, so `19.990` equals `19.99` and `5.50` equals `5.5` (XEQ-3). Mongo carries `$numberDecimal` values; Search a plain number (the documented precision-limited divergence of 046).
